allowed_change: Only a node's final boundary key may have element coordinate4 and then stored bytes/filter mask must both equal0. All real lower keys retain element coordinate0. Other fourth-coordinate values fail closed.
right_boundary_semantics: A newly created right key has zero stored bytes and filter mask; each scaled coordinate increments the inserted chunk's scaled coordinate by one. Key encoding multiplies each scaled coordinate by its matching layout dimension. With verified element-size dimension4 and actual chunk element offset0, the generated final fence element coordinate is4. Existing final boundary keys may instead be ordinary zero-element-coordinate keys.
